One Skill. Every agent gets its own Postgres.

PGX is a lightweight, PostgreSQL-compatible database runtime built for disposable databases: one runtime, thousands of databases, each cloned copy-on-write in milliseconds and removed on its own. The PGX Skill teaches Claude Code, Cursor and Codex to use it: detect your project, import your development database schema-only into a template, and give every session its own branch with DATABASE_URL already set. Your PostgreSQL is read once and never written.

# Recommended: AI coding agents
npx skills add pgrundev/pgx --skill pgx

# Manual PGX installation
npx pgxdb@latest

Then, in your project, ask the agent:

Use PGX to give this project isolated databases for coding agents. Set everything up.

Installing a Skill executes nothing by itself. The agent performs the setup when the Skill is activated and your permissions allow it, and tells you what it did.

Skill-first setup

Project detection, PGX installation, template preparation and hook installation, driven by the agent.

Existing PostgreSQL

pgx copy --schema-only imports your schema (with migration bookkeeping) into a template. Data copies need your explicit approval.

PGX-only development

No PostgreSQL yet? An empty template and your framework's migrations are enough.

Per-agent isolation

Each session gets agent-<host>-<id>, its own database. Two agents never see each other's changes.

Fast branching

Copy-on-write clones on APFS, ZFS and reflink filesystems: tens of milliseconds whatever the template size.

Automatic cleanup

An idle TTL of two hours, extended while the agent works, and a ten-minute grace after the session. Nothing to remember.

Manual CLI, for developers who want control

pgx run                                   # a runtime and an `app` database, one command
pgx copy --from "$DATABASE_URL" --to app --schema-only
pgx branch app feature-123                # a disposable 2-hour branch
pgx agent exec -- bin/rails test          # any command in its own branch
pgx agent ls · pgx agent doctor · pgx ttl feature-123 4h · pgx drop feature-123
